name: Ghost Slayer (Su)
body:
Benefit(s): The ninja’s unarmed and weapon attacks are considered force effects for purposes of damaging incorporeal creatures for 1 round/level. During this time, any armor or natural armor bonus to AC the ninja has also count as force effects against attacks from incorporeal foes. Each use of this ability uses up 1 ki point.
